The Group's flagship products — Story TV in micro-drama and Master in micro-learning — have together placed two Eloelo apps in India's Top 10, reaching over 100 million Indians who consume short-form vertical content every day.Story TV is India's leading micro-drama platform, with 100M+ users and 5000+ original titles produced in partnership with studios like Balaji Telefilms and Applause Entertainment. **Job Title:** Talent Acquisition Specialist – Tech & Non-Tech (Contract)

**Location:** [ Bengaluru, HSR Layout, Karnataka]

**Contract Duration:** [ 6–12 Months], with potential for extension

**Reports To:** [ HR Manager]

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced and adaptable **Contract Talent Acquisition Specialist** to drive our end-to-end recruitment efforts across both technical and non-technical departments. In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to hiring managers, managing the full recruitment lifecycle for a diverse portfolio of roles—ranging from software engineers and product managers to marketing, and operations professionals.

The ideal candidate is a high-volume, quality-driven recruiter who seamlessly pivots between sourcing complex technical requirements and identifying top-tier business talent, all while ensuring a best-in-class candidate experience.

Key Responsibilities Technology Hiring

* **Strategic Sourcing:** Identify, engage, and pipeline passive technical candidates (e.g., Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Analyst, Product Managers) utilizing platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter, Hirist, and specialized tech communities.
* **Technical Screening:** Conduct comprehensive initial phone screens to assess fundamental technical competencies, familiarity with required tech stacks (e.g., Python, Java, AWS, React), and overall role alignment.
* **Hiring Manager Partnership:** Collaborate closely with Engineering and Product leaders to define role requirements, calibrate candidate profiles, and streamline the technical assessment/interview process.

Non-Technology Hiring

* **Versatile Sourcing:** Execute targeted search strategies for business-critical roles across GTM ( Marketing), Operations, Finance.
* **Behavioral & Competency Assessment:** Evaluate candidates for soft skills, business acumen, and cultural add, utilizing behavioral interviewing techniques to ensure long-term success in the organization.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Guide non-tech business leaders through the hiring process, providing market insights, compensation benchmarking, and strategic advice on organizational design.

Full-Cycle Recruitment & Operations

* **Pipeline Management:** Maintain a healthy and consistent pipeline of qualified candidates for active and future requisitions.
* **Process Excellence:** Manage the end-to-end process in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) (e.g., Keka, Fresh team), ensuring accurate data tracking, timely feedback loops, and compliance.
* **Candidate Experience:** Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates, ensuring responsive communication, transparent feedback, and a seamless interview coordination process.
* **Offer Negotiation:** Manage complex offer processes, including compensation structuring, equity (if applicable), and closing candidates in competitive markets.

Qualifications & Skills

* **Experience:** 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in a fast-paced corporate or agency environment, with a proven track record of successfully filling both technical and non-technical roles.
* **Tech Fluency:** Strong understanding of modern technology stacks, engineering workflows, and the ability to "talk tech" credibly with candidates and hiring managers.
* **Business Acumen:** Deep understanding of go-to-market and operational functions, with the ability to assess talent for diverse business needs.
* **Sourcing Expertise:** Advanced knowledge of Boolean search strings, X-Ray sourcing, LinkedIn Recruiter, and alternative candidate discovery channels.
* **Data-Driven:** Ability to utilize recruitment metrics (e.g., time-to-fill, pass-through rates, pipeline health) to optimize the hiring process and report to leadership.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a high degree of emotional intelligence and the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
* **Adaptability:** Highly organized and capable of managing 15+ open requisitions simultaneously while pivoting quickly as business priorities shift.

title: Senior Professional, Solutions Architect
description:
The Solution Architect is responsible for designing technology solutions within the Solution Delivery function across a global engineering and professional services organisation of over 75,000 employees, as a member of a global team of Solution Architects.

The role designs solutions primarily in support of corporate functions, while also supporting engineering and digital fee-earning business areas where required. Solutions may range from SaaS platforms requiring integration with enterprise systems through to bespoke applications developed to meet WSP's specific business requirements.

The role converts business needs into secure, scalable, supportable and cost-effective designs, predominantly on Microsoft Azure, that align with Enterprise Architecture and WSP policy and are approved through the Cloud Design Review Board (CDRB).

  

**Requirements & Solution Design**

* **Requirements Translation** – Convert business needs into clear technical specifications, working with business stakeholders and analysts to understand requirements and constraints.
* **End-to-End Solution Design** – Create holistic designs across applications, data, integration, cloud, infrastructure, security and supporting IT services.
* **Scalability & Performance** – Design systems for growth, resilience and reliability.
* **Integration & Data Movement** – Define API, integration, data movement and orchestration patterns across applications, SaaS platforms and enterprise systems.
* **Operational Design** – Define monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, support handover to service management, and plan for lifecycle and decommissioning.

**Technology Selection & Cost Efficiency**

* **Technology Selection** – Recommend appropriate tools, platforms and services, evaluating SaaS, platform and bespoke options. Where appropriate, facilitate the commissioning of technology resources.
* **Proof of Concept** – Develop or direct proof-of-concepts to validate architecture, technology choices and solution feasibility before committing to delivery.
* **Cost Efficiency** – Optimise solutions for performance and cost, promoting reuse of existing platforms and patterns.
* **Estimating & Costing** – Produce build and running-cost estimates for solution options to support business cases and investment approval.

**Governance, Risk & Quality**

* **Architectural Alignment** – Align solutions with Enterprise Architecture and WSP Infrastructure and InfoSec policy. ### **About JumpCloud®**

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

### **About the Role**

We're hiring a Staff Engineer to join JumpCloud's Cloud Platform organization, with a focus on observability and FinOps.

You'll own the questions that matter most as we scale toward 99.99% availability: can we see what's happening across the platform, how fast do we recover when something breaks, can we survive a regional outage, and are we spending enough to run it all? This is a hands-on staff role. You'll set the technical direction for observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and cloud cost, write the code and AI-driven automation that make it real, and work closely with engineering, customer support, finance, and leadership.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

**Observability**

* Set the technical direction for observability across JumpCloud's cloud platform: metrics, logs, traces, and events, on AWS and GCP.
* Build and run our observability stack (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), including standard instrumentation libraries and collectors that teams adopt by default.
* Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with service owners, and build the dashboards and burn-rate alerts that hold us to a 99.99% SLA.
* Cut alert noise. Make sure every page is actionable, routed to the right owner, and backed by a runbook.
* Shorten detection and recovery times (MTTD and MTTR) by improving tracing, correlation, and incident tooling.
* Manage observability cost itself: cardinality, log volume, sampling, and retention, so visibility grows without the bill growing with it.

**FinOps**

* Own cloud cost visibility: tagging standards, cost allocation by team and service, and showback reports that engineers actually read.
* Find and deliver savings through right-sizing, autoscaling, spot capacity, storage tiering, idle-resource cleanup, and data-transfer reduction.
* Shape our commitment strategy (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, committed-use discounts) with finance, based on real usage data.
* Build automation and guardrails, such as budget alerts, anomaly detection, and policy-as-code checks, that catch waste before it ships.
* Define unit economics, like cost per customer or per device, and make cost a normal input to design reviews.
* Partner with finance on forecasting and budgeting, and explain cloud spend clearly to leadership.

**Incident Management and AI-Driven Automation**

* Own the incident management process end to end: severity levels, on-call rotations, escalation paths, communication, and the tooling behind them.
* Lead major incidents as incident commander or senior escalation point, and keep customers and leadership informed.
* Run root cause analysis (RCA) for significant incidents, and drive the follow-up actions to completion so issues don't repeat.
* Build AI agents that correlate alerts, logs, traces, and recent changes to find the likely root cause automatically.
* Build self-healing automation and AI agents that detect and fix known issues before they escalate or reach customers, with safe guardrails and human approval where it matters.
* Measure and improve incident health over time: MTTD, MTTR, repeat incidents, and on-call load.

**Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery**

* Own JumpCloud's business continuity (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) strategy for the cloud platform.
* Define RTO and RPO targets with product and leadership, and design the architecture to meet them.
* Design and build the DR site and recovery environment across AWS and GCP, including data replication, backups, failover, and failback.
* Plan and run regular DR tests and failover drills, document the results, and close the gaps they reveal.
* Keep DR runbooks, recovery automation, and BCP plans current, and support audit and customer requests for evidence.

**Across Everything**

* Write production-quality Go or Python for tooling, exporters, data pipelines, and automation.
* Work closely with customer support teams: turn support tickets and escalations into monitoring, alerts, and fixes, and give support the visibility they need to answer customers quickly.
* Partner with product engineering teams on reliability, recoverability, and cost-aware design.
* Write design docs, review architecture across engineering, and mentor engineers on observability and cost-aware design.

### **We're Looking For**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years in platform, SRE, or infrastructure roles running 24/7 SaaS systems at scale.
* **Observability depth:** You've designed and run observability at scale with Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry. You know how to instrument services, set meaningful SLOs, and build alerts people trust.
* **FinOps track record:** You've cut cloud spend in a measurable way, and you can show the numbers. You're comfortable with AWS Cost Explorer, CUR, Kubecost, or similar tools, and with commitment planning.
* **Strong coding skills:** You've built production tooling and automation in Go or Python, not just dashboards and scripts.
* **AWS, GCP, and Terraform:** strong hands-on production experience with both AWS and GCP, and with Terraform for infrastructure as code. Production Kubernetes experience is expected.
* **Incident management:** You've owned on-call and incident processes, led major incidents, and run RCAs that led to lasting fixes.
* **AI and automation:** You've built automation for incident response or remediation, and you have hands-on experience building AI agents or LLM-based tools for root cause analysis or auto-remediation.
* **BCP and DR:** You've designed and tested disaster recovery for production SaaS systems, including RTO and RPO targets, DR sites, replication, and failover drills.
* **Engineering and customer focus:** You have a software engineering background and have worked closely with customer support teams to resolve issues and reduce customer impact.
* **Staff-level influence:** You've driven change across multiple teams without direct authority, and you can get engineers to care about both reliability and cost.
* Clear communication with engineers, finance, and leadership. You can turn usage and cost data into a simple story and a clear decision.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* A strong team player who lives our core values: building connections, thinking big, and getting 1% better every day.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* FinOps Certified Practitioner, or hands-on experience applying the FinOps Framework.
* Experience with cost tools such as CloudHealth, Vantage, Cloudability, or AWS Compute Optimizer.
* Experience building cost and usage data pipelines (AWS CUR, BigQuery billing export, Athena) and reporting on top of them.
* Experience running observability in-house at scale (Prometheus/Thanos/Mimir, Loki, Tempo) and weighing that against SaaS vendors.
* Experience with eBPF-based monitoring, continuous profiling, or real user monitoring.

**Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners (FDDPs) – Healthcare Domain**

**Converge for Healthcare | Deloitte Consulting**

**About the Role**

**The Team**

This role sits within Converge for Healthcare, Deloitte's industry-focused asset studio for healthcare, part of Deloitte Consulting's Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) practice. I&DT brings an engineering- and innovation-led mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology-enabled solutions.

Data Studio is Converge for Healthcare's foundational platform—combining agentic AI and analytics capabilities atop a unified healthcare data foundation to turn healthcare data into decision-ready insight and automated action across the Converge for Healthcare product portfolio.

Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners are the business and domain half of Converge for Healthcare's Forward Deployed model. Where Product Forward Deployed Engineers (pFDEs) cover product and technology, FDDPs cover business and domain—partnering with pFDEs, client account teams, and product teams to define the real client problem, prove measurable value, and identify where the platform can deliver more, feeding real-world domain learnings back into the platform roadmap.

**Position Summary**

As a Forward Deployed Domain Practitioner within Converge for Healthcare, you will work directly with clients, Deloitte Consulting's broader Health Care consulting practice, and Converge Health's product and engineering teams. Paired with a pFDE on each engagement, you'll bring the client-domain fluency that shapes what gets built on Data Studio and why—defining the business problem and success criteria, aligning client stakeholders on what value means, and translating real operational workflows into the requirements, rules, and edge cases the pFDE builds against.

This is a domain-led, business-facing role grounded in production reality rather than abstract requirements. You'll work alongside real users, real workflows, and real data, on engagements that are scoped, time-boxed, and exit-oriented—leaving behind documented domain artifacts and reusable patterns so that each deployment makes the next one materially faster.

The role draws on healthcare breadth rather than a single specialty, spanning provider and payer domains—from revenue cycle, utilization management, and clinical operations to network strategy, risk adjustment, actuarial, and beyond.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Work You'll Do**

* **Presales & opportunity shaping:** Partner with Health Care consulting teams, account teams, and pFDEs during the sales cycle—leading business discovery, mapping current-state workflows, and building the value hypothesis and business case, while the pFDE leads technical discovery and demonstrations, to qualify client needs into Product fit or out to Services as custom scope.

* **Business problem definition & success criteria:** Frame each use case around a concrete operational problem, establish baseline performance, and define measurable outcomes the client and Deloitte agree on (e.g., denial rates, days in A/R, prior authorization turnaround, coding accuracy, care-gap closure).

* **Domain-to-build translation:** Translate business needs into the workflow logic, decision rules, policy references, exceptions, and acceptance criteria the pFDE builds against—and contribute domain-accurate, labelled test cases to the use case's evaluation set so agent outputs are judged against how the work is actually done.

* **Use case discovery beyond the original ask:** Surface adjacent, domain-specific use cases grounded in what you observe in the client's workflows and data, size their value, and route them through engagement governance and the product roadmap—never through informal commitments on features or timelines.

* **Stakeholder alignment & adoption:** Build alignment among client executives, operational leaders, and front-line users on what value means for the engagement, and lead the process change, training, and adoption activities that turn a working capability into one people actually use.

* **Value realization & measurement:** Stay engaged post-launch to track outcomes against the agreed baseline, diagnose where value is or isn't landing, and develop the evidence and client value stories that support adoption, renewal, and platform growth.

* **Field-to-product feedback & reusable domain assets:** Capture recurring domain patterns, workflow variations, and policy or regulatory shifts, translate them into concrete use-case and capability requests for Product Managers, and codify them into reusable domain playbooks, value frameworks, and use-case definitions for the next client.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 8+ years of experience in healthcare consulting, provider or payer operations, or a domain-specialist role in healthcare technology

* 4+ years of client-facing experience leading business discovery, process redesign, or business case development

* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders

* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and its nuances

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Public Health, Health Informatics, Nursing or another clinical discipline, such as an MBA, MHA, or MPH, or another relevant advanced degree

* Relevant professional credentials (e.g., HFMA CRCR or CHFP, AAPC or AHIMA coding certifications, clinical licensure such as RN, or SOA actuarial credentials)

* Experience with AI, automation, or advanced analytics implementations in a healthcare setting

* Experience in product- or platform-based delivery models, as distinct from purely services-based delivery

**Core Competencies**

* Domain-first profile—deep healthcare business and operational expertise paired with enough technical fluency to partner credibly with engineers on agentic AI and data solutions

* Strong healthcare domain knowledge spanning provider and/or payer domains—such as revenue cycle, utilization management, care management, clinical operations, network strategy, risk adjustment, or actuarial—with the versatility to apply it across multiple areas rather than a single specialty

* Proven ability to diagnose operational workflows, quantify improvement opportunities, and build credible business cases and ROI models that client executives act on

* Practical understanding of what agentic AI can and cannot do reliably—human-in-the-loop design, accuracy-versus-automation trade-offs, and how to judge agent outputs for domain correctness—without needing to write code

* Working knowledge of healthcare data and data standards (e.g., claims, remittances, EMR data, X12 EDI, HL7, FHIR) at a business level—what the data means, where it breaks, and how data quality affects business outcomes

* Fluency in the regulatory and policy landscape that shapes healthcare workflows—such as CMS rules, payer medical and reimbursement policies, coding standards (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS), prior authorization requirements, and HIPAA

* Strong requirements and process skills—process mapping, decision tables, use-case definition, and acceptance criteria that engineers can build and test against

* Judgment to size each engagement—recognizing when a client problem maps to a proven use case, when it needs meaningful extension, and when it is custom scope better served by Services

* Commercial instinct grounded in client value—spotting where the platform can do more for a client and framing it in outcome terms, while respecting engagement governance and the product roadmap

* Change management and adoption experience, including redesigning roles and workflows around automation and bringing front-line teams along

* Intellectual curiosity about how AI is changing the way healthcare work gets done, and a strong pull toward rethinking workflows rather than automating them as they are

* Executive presence and client-facing credibility to lead business conversations with senior stakeholders while working fluidly with engineering and product teams in the same engagement

* Ability to build trust and durable working relationships quickly with client stakeholders and account teams in predominantly virtual and distributed delivery environments

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop client-facing materials and business cases, lead discovery workshops, and work effectively across distributed teams and international time zones

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria.
